name: r0-geglu-ldg256-2d-stel
author: solx-loop
description: A pure one-pass elementwise stream: one launch, a 2-D grid of 5 CTAs per row with 128 threads, each thread two 256-bit loads (gate, linear) and one 256-bit store under L2 evict_last, GELU computed as a*sigmoid(2u) with one exp and one reciprocal. Evict_last stores cut the in-window write-back of the harness's dirty L2 lines, which is what separates this from a plain copy at M/L.
